_howto: To add a video: drop the .mp4 into /videos, add a poster image to /videos/posters (optional), then add an entry below. format: "wide" (16:9, shows under Full-Length) or "vertical" (9:16, shows under Shorts). Newest date shows first. Set featured: true on the one video you want at the top of the Watch page and on the homepage.
